title: 第7章 陈阳醒来
novel_title: 觉醒阴阳神功：分手后我爽麻了
content_zh:
杨婷站在一旁，垂着手，语气恭敬地摇了摇头：“不清楚，我们找到他的时候，他已经倒在地上，出租屋里一片凌乱，没有发现其他人的踪迹，也没有找到打斗留下的其他线索。”

    顿了顿，杨婷眼神里带着几分奇怪，偷偷瞟了苏冰一眼：“不过在调查他的过程中，我们发现他的银行卡里，今天突然进账了100多万。”

    苏冰的眼神瞬间变得更加复杂，指尖微微蜷缩，心里暗暗思忖：难道他昨晚与自己发生关系，不是意外？

    而是有预谋的？

    压下心底的疑惑，苏冰抬眸，语气依旧冰冷：“那笔钱是谁给他的？查清楚了吗？”

    “不清楚，”杨婷连忙摇头，“我们还没来得及深入调查，只是查到这笔钱是分多次转入的，来源比较零散。”

    “马上去查！”苏冰语气坚定，不容置疑，“另外，立刻去核实，他今天从酒店出来之后，具体去了哪些地方，做了什么，一丝细节都不能放过。”

    “是，总裁！”杨婷连忙点头应下，转身就要去安排。

    苏冰却再次看向病床上的陈阳，眼神复杂难辨，有疑惑，有恨意，还有一丝连她自己都没察觉的好奇。

    沉默了片刻，她终究还是站起身，转身快步走出了病房，背影冷艳而决绝。

    第二天中午，阳光透过病房的窗户，洒在病床上。

    病床上的陈阳缓缓睁开了眼睛，眼神还有些迷茫，他眨了眨眼，看着周围陌生的白色墙壁、输液架，还有身上的病号服，一时有些意外，心里充满了疑惑。

    是谁把自己送到医院来的？

    脑海中瞬间闪过昨晚的画面：唐欣悦的冷漠、赵凯的嚣张，还有自己被砸晕在地的剧痛与屈辱。

    一股怒火再次涌上心头，他攥紧拳头，指节泛白，眼底闪过一丝戾气。

    但很快，这股怒火就渐渐消散，取而代之的是一种释然。

    他在心里暗暗想道：难道这是老天爷的旨意？

    自己修炼阴阳神功，本就需要找到纯阴体质的女人，与之阴阳交融才能激活更多神通。

    如果没有与唐欣悦分手，以自己重感情的性子，绝对不可能做出背叛她的事情，也就无法安心修炼。
content_en:
Yang Ting stood aside, lowering her hands, and shook her head respectfully: "I don't know. When we found him, he had already fallen to the ground. The rental house was in a mess. No trace of other people was found, and no other clues left by the fight were found."

After a pause, Yang Ting glanced at Su Bing secretly with a strange look in her eyes: "But during the process of investigating him, we found that more than 1 million yuan was suddenly credited to his bank card today."

Su Bing's eyes instantly became more complicated, her fingertips curled up slightly, and she thought to herself: Was it not an accident that he had sex with her last night?

But premeditated?

Suppressing the doubts in her heart, Su Bing raised her eyes, her tone still cold: "Who gave him that money? Have you found out?"

"I don't know," Yang Ting shook her head quickly, "We haven't had time to conduct an in-depth investigation, but we just found that the money was transferred in multiple times, and the sources were relatively scattered."

"Go and check immediately!" Su Bing said firmly, leaving no room for doubt. "In addition, go and verify immediately. Where did he go and what did he do after he came out of the hotel today? No detail can be spared."

"Yes, President!" Yang Ting nodded quickly and turned around to make arrangements.

Su Bing looked at Chen Yang on the hospital bed again, her eyes were complicated and difficult to distinguish, including confusion, hatred, and a hint of curiosity that she didn't even notice.

After a moment of silence, she finally stood up, turned around and walked out of the ward quickly, her back looking cold and decisive.

At noon the next day, the sun shone through the window of the ward and onto the bed.

Chen Yang slowly opened his eyes on the hospital bed, his eyes still a little confused. He blinked and looked at the unfamiliar white walls, IV poles, and hospital gown around him. He was a little surprised for a moment, and his heart was full of doubts.

Who sent him to the hospital?

The scene from last night flashed through his mind: Tang Xinyue's indifference, Zhao Kai's arrogance, and the severe pain and humiliation of being knocked unconscious to the ground.

A surge of anger surged into his heart again, and he clenched his fists, his knuckles turning white, and a trace of anger flashed in his eyes.

But soon, the anger gradually dissipated and was replaced by a sense of relief.

He secretly thought in his heart: Is this God's will?

To practice yin and yang magic by yourself, you need to find a woman with a pure yin constitution, and blend her yin and yang to activate more magical powers.

If he had not broken up with Tang Xinyue, with his emotional temperament, he would never have betrayed her, and he would not have been able to practice with peace of mind.
